h,w = a.shape
# tile-based CLAHE

out = np.zeros_like(a)
nb_x = (w+tile-1)//tile; nb_y=(h+tile-1)//tile
for i in range(nb_y):

        blk=a[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(np.uint8)

        # clip
        excess=np.sum(np.maximum(hist-clip*(blk.size/256),0))
        hist=np.minimum(hist,clip*(blk.size/256)); hist+=excess/256
        cdf=np.cumsum(hist); cdf/=cdf[-1]
        lut=(cdf*255).astype(np.uint8)
        out[y0:y1,x0:x1]=lut[blk]
